fields.title: XML column
fields.description: Select the column containing the XML cells to be combined and written to the output file.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Output file
fields.description: Enter the path to the output file where the combined XML document will be written.

fields.title: Overwrite existing files
fields.description: If checked, an existing output file will be overwritten. If unchecked, the node will fail if the output file already exists.

fields.title: Root element
fields.description: Enter the qualified name of the root element that will wrap all XML cells in the output file. You may use a namespace prefix if the corresponding namespace is declared in the root element attributes below (e.g. <tt>ns:root</tt>).

fields.title: Attributes of the root element
fields.description: Define the attributes to be added to the root element. Use <tt>xmlns</tt> or <tt>xmlns:prefix</tt> as the name to declare XML namespaces.
